records.excerpt: Natural England publishes Ramsar (England), last updated 13 July 2026. It covers listed Wetlands of International Importance, excludes proposed sites, provides OGC/ESRI REST links, identifies Open Government Licence, and states there are no public access constraints subject to the identified licence.
records.web_line_scope: dataset title, publisher, update date, summary, data links, access constraints and licence information
records.record_scope: official dataset identity, designation scope, service availability and licence

records.excerpt: The official Ramsar_England FeatureServer describes listed Ramsar wetlands, excludes proposed sites, exposes layer 0, supports JSON queries and has a maximum record count of 2000.
records.web_line_scope: service description, service item ID, supported query format, layer listing and record limit
records.record_scope: official ArcGIS FeatureServer identity and bounded-query capability

records.excerpt: Layer 0 is Ramsar (England) Natural England, an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer. Published fields include OBJECTID, NAME, CODE, AREA, GRID_REF, EASTING, NORTHING, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, STATUS, GIS_DATE and VERSION.
records.web_line_scope: layer name, geometry type, object ID and published field definitions
records.record_scope: official layer schema and selected non-geometry fields

records.excerpt: The official harvested metadata identifies Natural England as responsible party, the Ramsar FeatureServer endpoint, EPSG:27700, protected-sites topic, Open Government Licence use constraint and no public access constraints.
records.web_line_scope: resource locator, coordinate reference system, constraints and responsible organisation
records.record_scope: official metadata provenance, endpoint, CRS and licensing boundary

records.excerpt: Natural England explains that OGL data can be used for commercial or non-commercial purposes without payment or permission when source copyright attribution is included, and directs users to the Open Data Geoportal and Data.GOV.UK.
records.web_line_scope: open data and copyright, Open Data Geoportal and Data.GOV.UK access sections
